## Design tokens (framework CSS `@theme inline`)

The only legal colors. Prefix with `bg-` / `text-` / `border-` / `ring-`
(e.g. `--color-muted-foreground` -> `text-muted-foreground`). A `-foreground`
token is the readable color to place *on* its same-named surface. Opacity
modifiers are fine (`bg-destructive/10`). Never a raw hex, a Tailwind palette
class (`bg-blue-500`), or bare `bg-white`/`text-black` — `npm run lint` errors.

- `accent`
- `accent-foreground`
- `background`
- `border`
- `border-dark`
- `card`
- `card-foreground`
- `control-disabled`
- `control-disabled-icon`
- `control-disabled-knob`
- `destructive`
- `destructive-foreground`
- `destructive-hover`

- `foreground`
- `highlight`

### Spacing scale

4px base unit — only these steps (DESIGN.md §5):

| Step | `1` | `2` | `3` | `4` | `6` | `8` | `12` | `16` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| px | 4 | 8 | 12 | 16 | 24 | 32 | 48 | 64 |

Arbitrary values are allowed only when they land on the scale (`max-h-[300px]` is
fine, `mt-[7px]` errors). For a token-driven length use Tailwind v4's CSS-var
shorthand — `max-w-(--container-max)`, not `max-w-[1280px]`.
